title: A Generalization of UQ Rings
summary: We examine the newly defined class of {\it $n$-$UQ$ rings} described by the condition that $u^n - 1 \in QN(R)$ for every unit $u \in U(R)$, where $QN(R)$ denotes the set of quasi-nilpotent elements (see \cite{Tien}). This class naturally extends the recently defined class of rings in \cite{daoa} and \cite{dam}, as well as expectedly generalizes previously explored concepts such as $UJ$, $UU$ and $UQ$ rings. We conduct here a comprehensive structural analysis of these $n$-$UQ$ rings and study their stability under various ring-theoretic constructions including matrix rings, group rings,…
